mem-hc-dbg.description: mem-hc on a debug-only tree that logs SWA admission accounting (free/evictable sliding slots at select, load-back, commit, pre-alloc and alloc-time eviction), to locate the C28 SWA admission under-reservation. Run in a 28G scope.

mem-hc-fix.description: mem-hc with the SWA admission fix: SGLANG_OPT_HICACHE_PIN_LOAD_BACK_WINDOW=1 also pins best_match_node during prefill admission, so device SWA a HiCache load-back will lock leaves the evictable budget before the check (the C28 crash of mem-hc). Run in a 28G scope.

mem-hc-fix-smallpool.description: Exactness only: mem-hc-fix on a 16K-token device pool (full and SWA), so multi-turn sessions at concurrency 1 are evicted to the host pool between turns and every later turn is a HiCache load-back. Control: mem-final (device hits).

mem-hc-smallpool.description: Exactness attribution: mem-hc (no admission fix) on the same 16K-token device pool as mem-hc-fix-smallpool, so every later multi-turn turn is a HiCache load-back.

mem-hc-fix-smallpool-direct.description: Exactness diagnostic: mem-hc-fix-smallpool with the direct copy path and layer_first host layout instead of the kernel io path and page_first, to test whether the load-back divergence comes from the kernel/page_first transfer.

mem-base-hc-smallpool.description: Exactness attribution to upstream: PC's control mem-base (no study levers: no L8 vocab table, no L9 override, ratio 0.3) + HiCache (12 GB, write-through, kernel io, page_first) on a 16K-token device pool, so every later multi-turn turn is a load-back. Control: mem-base.

mem-hc-fix-smallpool-rt.description: Byte-level HiCache round trip: mem-hc-fix-smallpool on a debug tree (fix + G4POC_DEBUG_HICACHE_ROUNDTRIP) that compares device vs host KV bytes per token and layer at every write-through and load-back ack (full and SWA pools) and checks the full->SWA mapping after loads.

mem-hc-fix2.description: mem-hc-fix + the write-through fence: SGLANG_OPT_HICACHE_FENCE_WRITE_THROUGH=1 orders each D2H write-through after the forwards already queued on the forward stream, so a node inserted while its KV is still being written is not copied half-written (the multi-turn load-back inexactness). Run in a 28G scope.

mem-hc-fix2-smallpool.description: Exactness only: mem-hc-fix2 on a 16K-token device pool, so every later multi-turn turn is a HiCache load-back. Control: mem-final.

mem-hc-fix2-smallpool-rt.description: Byte-level round trip on mem-hc-fix2-smallpool: debug tree with the device-vs-host comparison at every write and load ack (expect 0 mismatches with the fence).

final-hc.description: Final-stack candidate: final-mem-c1-c2a (mem-final + C1 MoE config + C2-A sm120 FP8-KV tiles) + HiCache (12 GB, write-through, kernel io, page_first) + both SGLang fixes: SGLANG_OPT_HICACHE_PIN_LOAD_BACK_WINDOW (SWA admission crash) and SGLANG_OPT_HICACHE_FENCE_WRITE_THROUGH (stale write-through copies). Tree a0491db764 = 1425761173 + the two fix commits + a comment-only correction (branch jumanzii/g4poc-final-hicache). Run in a 28G scope.

final-hc-smallpool.description: Exactness only: final-hc on a 16K-token device pool, so every later multi-turn turn is a HiCache load-back. Control: final-mem-c1-c2a (device hits).

final-hc-qr-pfx.description: PC2's final-hc role-play arm (final-hc-qr: 0.85 static fraction, 1024-token prefill chunks) on a debug tree (a0491db764 + a log-only per-request prefix split: device hit, HiCache host hit and load-back size for full/SWA, and loaded host slots made stale by SWA tombstone recovery). Numerics unchanged. 28G scope.
